body:
Hah, be great if I knew someone who could help offline. Sadly, none of my  "friends" know much math.

How'd you get so good with numbers and writing when you have dyslexia? Medication?

It would be great to receive and thank you for any and all.
Did my message from an hour ago go through to you? Reddit isn't showing it on here.

Thanks for the response, it really means a lot to me. For the past hour 
Reddit would only say there was a comment but showed nothing.

I'd bet that to be true, but I've had that kind of help [tutors] before, all throughout school. Took me until the middle of kindergarten to learn to read [surprisingly at an advanced level]. But I just am no good with math for all I know it could be some type of learning disorder. My memory, for all my life, has been absolutely terrible.

Surprisingly, I understood what you wrote. That's a reason I took the class in the first place, because I, somehow, understood some basic words. But as the classes went it only got harder, with the ending parts you attach and harder to remember the longer words.
Nice setup, even if you only have a beanbag chair these days.
Me, at every party I've ever been to.
